:wave: I'm Heath Sanchez, founder of Metalogic Labs (metalogiclabs.xyz), based in New Zealand.

We're building infrastructure that turns AI-generated claims into auditable outcomes - verified proofs, refutation certificates, or named obstructions. The core engine is MathGraph (mathgraph.org), an open-source operational framework for computational metalogic built on Lean 4.

Current work: After a strong result in Stage 1, we're competing in Stage 2 of the SAIR Foundation Mathematics Distillation Challenge (co-organized by Terence Tao) - generating machine-verifiable Lean 4 certificates for magma equational implication problems (proofs or finite counterexamples). The architecture uses a four-layer solver strategy combining lookup tables, deterministic Lean templates, brute-force search, and LLM-generated certificates.

What I'm looking for: A technical co-founder who owns the formal verification architecture. Specifically someone with:

  • Lean 4 experience - proof writing, tactic development, or autoformalization
  • Background in formal methods, type theory, or mathematical logic
  • Interest in building this as infrastructure, not just a research project

What I bring: Operator experience building and scaling technology companies. I handle fundraising, GTM, narrative, and execution. Investor conversations are starting now.

This is a co-founder role - ground floor, meaningful equity, shared ownership of the direction.

Reach out here or email with any questions heath.sanchez@metalogiclabs.xyz
